title: Cyrus and the Hollow Revisited
author: Sebastian Dunmore
blurb: Jonah Dravenmoor, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
